status_at_amendment: no annotation exists; annotation package not delivered; reference not locked; evaluation not run
reason: the paper is an engineering study; a single resident reference may not be accepted as ground truth
change: The RFMiD 1.0 Test camera A/B/C annotation study becomes an optional secondary sub-study. Its analysis plan, scripts and hashes are unchanged and still apply if it is conducted.

If conducted, the annotator is described as a trained annotator (ophthalmology resident), and the same annotator also annotates a calibration subset of a public multi-expert dataset so that agreement with experts is reported; the calibration subset is defined in the new pre-registration before any annotation.

The primary ground-truth evaluation moves to public multi-device datasets with expert optic-disc annotations (candidates: Chaksu, REFUGE, Drishti-GS), under a separate pre-registration locked before any FE output on those datasets is viewed.
unchanged: RFMiD 1.0 camera validity and seed-agreement analyses (no ground truth) remain the observational evidence
